1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of __at least 1,000 Da and less than 2000 Da__ and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a __modified__ multivalent cation crosslinker.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __selectively chosen from__ polyethylenimine.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate, dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants, wherein at least one polyanion is __present in a concentration sufficient to stabilize the nanoparticle__.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate in __effective amounts for crosslinking. 

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions __in concentrations suitable for maintaining stability of the nanoparticle. 

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex __nanoparticle is characterized by an average particle size of approximately 100 to 900 nm in diameter.__

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __selected based on stability criteria in the formulation.__

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising __any of the metals from the group consisting of__ Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1, wherein said composition is __designed for sustained release applications;__ b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethyacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or N,N-dimethylacrylamide, which is __tailored to respond to the conditions in the reservoir. 

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is __selectively chosen from brine, seawater, or other reservoir fluids.__
